en_text: This app shows behavior that may read or receive SMS messages. Review it carefully before allowing access.
This app asks for special screen-reading access that could let it act on your behalf. Check whether that access is truly needed.
This app can place a screen over other apps. That could hide or change what you see while you act.
This app may contain or load another app from outside the usual install screen. Review it carefully.
This app may not appear normally in your app list. Its behavior may be harder to notice or manage.
The app contains a protected reference linked to a bot service. The underlying secret is not shared or used.
The app refers to an external cloud address that may receive information. Review the app before continuing.
The app contains a fixed internet address. Its presence may need further review.
The app is packed or hidden in a way that makes a complete review difficult.
The app is not using the signing certificate associated with the claimed brand in the official list.
The app name looks like a well-known brand from the official list. It may be an imitation.
The message urges you to act immediately. A calm review may help you avoid a costly mistake.
The message includes a warning or threat to prompt action. Check it through an official channel.
The message asks for payment or financial details. Verify the request with the organisation directly.
The message claims authority or affiliation that may not be genuine. Verify the sender separately.
The message asks you to install an app outside the usual trusted app source. Check it carefully first.
The app name or brand does not agree with the name in the message. Verify both through official sources.
The assessment found a combination of signals associated with high risk. Proceed with caution.
A complete review could not be finished. This result is not a reassurance, and the app may still carry risk.
